title: The Phoenix Project
creator: Gene Kim, Kevin Behr and George Spafford
review: A novel about Bill, a newly promoted IT operations manager who has 90 days to rescue a late, over-budget project. It made the Three Ways of DevOps (flow, feedback, and continual learning) concrete for me: each chapter shows a real problem, like unplanned work or one overloaded engineer, before naming the idea that fixes it.
